notes: 182 bars of an unsymmetric section (a T, a channel, an angle): their axis through the centroid, joined to the box centre's nodes by rigid arms.
12 rods or ties work axially: pinned at their own ends, their weight carried to them (no bending under it); analysisAxial on an element changes it.

20 members braced by their sheeting: held straight across in the sheeting's plane (along their section's width) between the members they rest on, at 32 nodes; the sheeting ties no member to another (no stressed skin). The members' own buckling checks keep their lengths.
No shells: the bars carry everything; the slabs only carry loads to them (the 45° rule), the load-bearing walls are line supports (every node of theirs held in translation, free to turn).
Bars as Timoshenko beams, their shear areas from the section (EN 1993-1-1 §6.2.6(3) for steel, 5/6·A for a rectangle).
310 bars with eccentric ends, joined to their nodes by rigid arms.
242 bar end pieces pinned by default (the members a connection joins); analysis.setReleases changes them.
„W+X/s”: 3.15 kN of the wind on the façades goes straight to the ground (the strip at their foot), outside the bars' sums.
„W+X/p”: 3.15 kN of the wind on the façades goes straight to the ground (the strip at their foot), outside the bars' sums.
„W-X/s”: 3.15 kN of the wind on the façades goes straight to the ground (the strip at their foot), outside the bars' sums.
„W-X/p”: 3.15 kN of the wind on the façades goes straight to the ground (the strip at their foot), outside the bars' sums.
„W+Y/s”: 1.99 kN of the wind on the façades goes straight to the ground (the strip at their foot), outside the bars' sums.
„W-Y/s”: 1.99 kN of the wind on the façades goes straight to the ground (the strip at their foot), outside the bars' sums.

Area loads on a framed roof: each rafter (or truss top chord; purlins where there are none) takes the load over its tributary width, half way to its neighbours (an edge one to the roof's edge); snow per horizontal projection (q·w·cos α along a sloping bar), other loads per true area.

Second order (P-Δ): each static combination solved with the bars' geometric stiffness of their axial forces, iterated; the cases stay first order. Along a bar the moment keeps its first-order shape between its ends: its own buckling is its check's (EN 1993-1-1 6.3).
Second order amplifies the sway most in „G1 + 1.5 W+Y/s + φ(−Y)”: × 2.134.

Global sway imperfections (EN 1993-1-1 5.3.2; the same form for concrete, EN 1992-1-1 5.2; timber by EN 1995-1-1 5.4.4): each ultimate combination solved four times, ±X and ±Y, with φ·NEd at the top and −φ·NEd at the foot of each compressed column, NEd of its first-order result; h = 7.68 m, αh = 0.722, φ up to 1/277 along X (m = 1), φ up to 1/277 along Y (m = 1). A combination's results are the envelope of its four.

EN 1993-1-1 5.3.2(4): in 22 ultimate combinations the horizontal loads are at least 0.15 of the vertical ones along X and Y: the sway imperfections could be left out there; they are kept, on the safe side.
„1.35 G1 + φ(+X)”: Second order: unstable, the loads are past the critical ones (αcr < 1). Left out of the envelopes and the checks.
„1.35 G1 + φ(−X)”: Second order: unstable, the loads are past the critical ones (αcr < 1). Left out of the envelopes and the checks.
One-way members slack in 53 combinations: Member Ø20….
„G2” holds nothing: left out of the combinations.
„Q-A” holds nothing: left out of the combinations.
„S+Y” holds nothing: left out of the combinations.
„S-Y” holds nothing: left out of the combinations.
„W+Y/p” holds nothing: left out of the combinations.
„W-Y/p” holds nothing: left out of the combinations.
The arrangements of the snow and the directions of the wind are alternatives: each combination takes one of them (87 combinations).
Indicative: EN 1990 Annex A1, the recommended values (γG 1.35, γQ 1.5, ψ by Table A1.1, snow for sites up to 1000 m).
Not made yet: snow with the imposed load on roofs (EN 1991-1-1 3.3.2); the seismic combination comes with the seismic parameters (its own envelope).
